rival_reading: A routine warehouse schedule for agricultural supplies could return a bay key before a dispatch revision; ordinary freight counts do not establish a failed evacuation.
gloss: A bay-key return and a dispatch revision carry different times.
title: Return count completed with bay still sealed
body: The bay key is logged back before the dispatch change takes effect. A child's star is scratched on the lunchbox; the only completed count is keys returned, not loads still inside.

rival_reading: Emergency crews could stock water for a response route, and a receiving gap may be an inventory delay rather than program-related exposure.
gloss: A field-route water allotment appears before a receiving entry.
title: Field allotment recorded before receipt
body: The notebook lists water for the field route before any receiving mark appears. Someone tucked a biscuit wrapper inside; the warehouse count records containers, not who handled them.
